messages.author: 0111ed37d2662b85
messages.subject: monitor adaptation in block RW
parts:
Many thanks to the developers and countless contributors for all the great work building this useful software.

Is there a way to monitor the adaptation steps used in NIMBLE's RW and block RW samplers? I am having an issue with a some samplers that get stuck after several thousand iterations, even after specifying thoughtful initial proposal covariances, and I think being able to see the details of the proposal distributions might be helpful. 

Thanks,
Henry

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: monitor adaptation in block RW
parts:
Yes, there are nice facilities for recording this information built into both NIMBLE's RW and RW_block samplers.  You can "turn these on" by setting the nimble package option:

> nimbleOptions(saveMCMChistory = TRUE)

Then you can retrieve this information, using member methods of the samplers, e.g.:

> Cmcmc$samplerFunctions$contentsList[[i]]$getScaleHistory()
or,
> Cmcmc$samplerFunctions$contentsList[[i]]$getPropCovHistory()

You'll need to replace "i" with the correct sampler number, in the lines above.  To see what methods are available, I'd suggest looking at the source code for, for example, the RW_block sampler, available here:

https://github.com/nimble-dev/nimble/blob/devel/packages/nimble/R/MCMC_samplers.R

Great question!  Keep in touch.

Daniel
